units: <cite ref="Pesachim 76a:1">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ לתוך צ׳</he> if cold meat is put into cold milk.
<cite ref="Pesachim 76a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בחרס צ׳</he> when the earthen vessel was cold.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:3">Dem. V, 3</cite> <he>מעשר … על הצ׳ ומן הצ׳ וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>ומן הצוננות</he>, corr. acc.) one may give the tithes from the hot bread for the cold, and from the cold for the hot; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צוֹנְנִין</he>, <cite ref="R00208"><he>צוֹנִּין</he></cite>; <he>צוֹנְנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 94b:6">Pes. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>כל העולם … ומעיינות צ׳ וכ׳</he> the whole world (the earth) is hot, and the springs are cold &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:1:10">Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ</cite> top <he>תבשיל צונין</he> a dish of cold things (not yet cooked).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:15">Gen. R. s. 12</cite>, end (some ed. incorr. <he>צונן</he>). Y. Sabb. XX, 17ᶜ bot. <cite ref="R00208"><he>צונין</he></cite>, opp. <he>פושרין</he>; a. fr.
